query.description: SODA query against any data.bts.gov dataset (catalog alias or 4x4 id).

dataset.desc: catalog alias (monthly_stats, border_crossings) or dataset id (crem-w557)

$where.desc: SoQL filter; quote text and dates: state = 'Texas' AND date >= '2024-01-01'

$group.desc: SoQL group by, e.g. 'border, measure' with $select 'border, measure, sum(value)'

$order.desc: SoQL order; default :id gives stable paging

csv.description: Same query as CSV (for manual download in a browser).

monthly_stats.name: Monthly Transportation Statistics
monthly_stats.description: One row per month (1947-present, most series start 2000 or later): airline traffic, on-time performance, transit ridership, freight rail, VMT, fuel prices, vehicle sales, fatalities, Transportation Services Index, border crossings, employment, construction spending. 136 columns (date, index, 134 indicators); see monthly_stats_fields.

border_crossings.name: Border Crossing Entry Data
border_crossings.description: Inbound crossings at U.S.-Canada and U.S.-Mexico land ports by port, state, month (1996-present) and measure (Trucks, Personal Vehicles, Personal Vehicle Passengers, Pedestrians, Buses, Bus Passengers, Trains, Train Passengers).

tsi.name: Transportation Services Index and Seasonally-Adjusted Transportation Data
tsi.description: Monthly TSI (freight, passenger, combined) with the seasonally adjusted component series.

supply_chain.name: Supply Chain and Freight Indicators
supply_chain.description: Interagency freight and supply-chain indicators (port, rail, truck, air cargo).

tet.name: Transportation Economic Trends (TET) data
tet.description: Data behind BTS Transportation Economic Trends: GDP contribution, spending, employment, productivity.

daily_mobility.name: Daily Mobility Statistics
daily_mobility.description: Daily trips and population staying home by national, state and county level (2019-2024; ended April 2024).

airfare_quarterly.name: Average Air Fare by Quarter
airfare_quarterly.description: Average domestic itinerary air fare by quarter (nominal and inflation-adjusted).

airfare_carrier.name: Average Air Fare by Carrier
airfare_carrier.description: Average domestic market air fare by carrier.

t100_segment_origin.name: T-100 Segment Summary by Origin Airport
t100_segment_origin.description: Commercial air passengers, seats, freight and mail by origin airport and year.

t100_segment.name: T-100 Segment Summary
t100_segment.description: Commercial air passengers, seats, freight and mail by year.

motor_fuel_sales.name: Monthly Motor Fuel Sales Reported by States
motor_fuel_sales.description: Monthly gasoline and special-fuel sales by state from the FHWA Monthly Motor Fuel Report.

motor_fuel_tax.name: Tax Rates by Motor Fuel and State
motor_fuel_tax.description: Motor fuel tax rates by fuel type and state.

vehicles_entering.name: Vehicles Entering U.S. by Country
vehicles_entering.description: Passenger vehicles and trucks entering the United States from Canada and Mexico.

container_ports.name: Top 25 Container Ports by TEU
container_ports.description: Annual TEU volumes and rankings of the top 25 U.S. container ports.

bikeshare_ridership.name: Docked Bikeshare Ridership
bikeshare_ridership.description: Docked bikeshare trips by system and period.

bikeshare_systems.name: Bikeshare and E-scooter Systems by Year and City
bikeshare_systems.description: Cities served by docked, dockless bikeshare and e-scooter systems by year (2015-).

state_tpfs.name: Aggregate State Transportation Public Finance Statistics
state_tpfs.description: State and local transportation revenues and expenditures by state.

transport_satellite.name: Transportation Satellite Accounts Table
transport_satellite.description: Contribution of transportation (in-house and for-hire) to GDP by industry.

air_fuel_efficiency.name: Air Carrier Fuel Efficiency by Year
air_fuel_efficiency.description: Air carrier fuel consumption and efficiency by year.
